title: Aftergraph Mission State Contract
description: Canonical mission lifecycle state machine shared between AIE (normative authority), ISR (research lifecycle), and TG (runtime enforcement). Derived from ISR SPEC-001 Mission Lifecycle FSM and the AIE Mission dataclass. Version 1.0 — first cross-repo contract.

state.description: Current lifecycle state. Transitions are constrained by the state machine below.

allowed_transitions.description: Map of state → set of allowed next states (ISR SPEC-001 FSM). Consumers MUST enforce these transitions.

invariants.description: Lifecycle invariants that MUST hold at all times.

mission_invariants: Invariant 1 (ISR SPEC-001): Complete != Verified — a mission in VERIFYING is not yet VERIFIED.
Invariant 2 (ISR SPEC-001): Evidence Gated — VERIFIED requires evidence records.
Invariant 3 (AIE TH-12): Execution-time revalidation MUST run immediately before any consequential action.
Invariant 4 (AIE W0.4): Authority leases persist across restarts via PersistentState (HMAC tamper-evidence).
